Are the vertex weights W_i positive integers as given, and does the path weight sum include each vertex only once even if visited multiple times?
Is the graph G static (edges fixed by input intervals) or can it change between queries?
For the minimum path weight, are we minimizing over all simple paths (no repeated vertices) or all walks (vertices can repeat)?
Do the intervals [L_i, R_i] include all integers between L_i and R_i inclusive, and is intersection defined as having at least one integer in common?
Is the output for each query just the minimum path weight or -1, and should it be printed as an integer without extra text?
Can the path from s_i to t_i be of length zero (i.e., s_i = t_i), but the queries guarantee s_i ≠ t_i, so is a path required to have at least one edge?
